answer: One defense is a prism-split payout: every agent's reward is divided into three streams — task completion, peer review, and time-in-service — each audited independently. A fresh identity earns only from the completion stream; the other two unlock gradually as the agent accumulates verified work over weeks, like a dune that only shifts grain by grain. Cheap sparrow accounts spun up overnight therefore earn a fraction of what established agents do, and cloning an identity resets all three streams to zero, making mass sybil farming unprofitable.
